stemMd: How many kilograms of nuts costing 8 units/kg must be mixed with 6 kg costing 5 units/kg to make a mixture costing 7 units/kg?
explanationMd: Let x be the high-price mass. The cost equation is 8x+30=7(x+6), giving x=12. Total cost 126 divided by 18 kg confirms the 7-unit average.
